version.name: 0.6.1-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Add harmony tools and chord palettes. Expand arpeggiator and phrase editing tools. Preserve explicit note-on/off pairs when editing overlapping notes. Improve playback following, zoom focus, and timeline navigation. Refine controller lane tools, tooltips, toolbar, and MIDI audition controls.

version.name: 0.6.2-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Fix disabled Apply buttons across the bottom toolbar's note tools. Preserve selected notes after pitch, velocity, and humanize previews.

version.name: 0.6.3-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Add ReaRoll, REAPER, FL Studio, and Ableton Live input presets. Add customizable note-grid mouse modifiers and a draw-mode shortcut. Add configurable smooth wheel scrolling and anchored wheel zoom. Improve MIDI take validation and editor interaction handling.

version.name: 0.7.0-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Add overlap-driven mono glides and independent MPE chord glides. Add MPE voice allocation, per-note expression and multi-note curve editing. Edit multiple MIDI items in the original piano roll. Rework chord palettes, note painting, controller lanes and editing tools. Preserve controller and sustain context during supported note edits. Refine compact toolbars, mouse tooltips and floating-window recall. Fix note drawing, resizing and glide playback at MIDI item boundaries.

version.name: 0.7.1-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Fix Shape velocity selection across editable MIDI channels and multiple items. Retain selected notes during Shape previews, Apply and Cancel. Clear stale Shape errors after a successful preview. Start the empty piano roll at project zero instead of a previous item's scroll position.

version.name: 0.7.2-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Fix Shape Apply staying disabled for valid single-item previews. Keep Shape open if committing a preview fails. Use native ReaImGui modifiers for drawing, selection and keyboard shortcuts. Read physical wheel modifiers only over unfocused ReaRoll on Windows and macOS, when js_ReaScriptAPI is installed.
